thought: She used to work the fields in rural Gujarat. In 2026, the Prime Minister praised her on national radio for installing solar panels instead.
support: Payal Munjpara, from a modest family in Dhrangadhra taluka, Surendranagar district, Gujarat, previously worked in agricultural fields. She trained as a Solar PV Technician-cum-Helper and now installs, wires and maintains rooftop solar systems across nearby districts under the PM Surya Ghar scheme - while mentoring other rural women and girls into technical, skill-based work. PM Modi praised her as a role model for rural girls on Mann Ki Baat, and she was invited as a special guest to the Red Fort Independence Day ceremony on August 15, 2026, later visiting Rashtrapati Bhavan. From the fields to the rooftops - and then to the national stage.
